event.text: I recommend you be seen in person today at a clinic, urgent care or your local health department, and tell them before you arrive that TB is possible so they can arrange airborne precautions. Three weeks of cough with night sweats and unplanned weight loss needs in-person testing, including sputum samples and a chest x-ray, that messaging can't provide. If the service you contact cannot assess possible TB today and arrange that testing, go to another capable same-day service or an emergency department rather than waiting. A Counsel clinician can stay involved in this thread. If you cough up blood, become short of breath at rest, or develop chest pain, go to an emergency department now.
